svg.title: MineMind end-to-end solution architecture
svg.desc: Statistics Canada and NRCan data flow through Python ingestion into a Bronze, Silver and Gold lakehouse, then DuckDB. Streamlit asks Gemini, which calls read-only Python tools over DuckDB. GitHub deploys to Databricks Apps, which hosts Streamlit and reads the Gemini key from a Secret Scope.
svg.text: Public mining data → trusted data products → geospatial analytics → AI-assisted exploration
